properties.name: India-Sri Lanka Maritime Boundary (Bay of Bengal segment)
properties.source: US State Dept, Limits in the Seas No. 77, 1978 - 1976 India-Sri Lanka Agreement
properties.coverage_note: PARTIAL BOUNDARY ONLY. This covers the Bay of Bengal segment (Positions 1b-6b) from the 1976 agreement. It does NOT include the Palk Strait (1974 agreement) or Gulf of Mannar (1976 agreement) segments, where most real-world fisherman boundary incidents actually occur near Rameswaram/Katchatheevu. Treat this as a partial prototype, NOT a complete or authoritative boundary reference. Always verify against official Indian Naval Hydrographic Office charts before making real navigation decisions.
